convert_rt_detr_checkpoint: convert an RT-DETR PyTorch checkpoint to HuggingFace format for a given model name
get_rt_detr_config: get the RT-DETR configuration for a specified model variant such as rtdetr_r50vd
create_rename_keys: create a list of key mappings to rename original checkpoint weights to HuggingFace naming conventions
read_in_q_k_v: split concatenated query-key-value projection matrices into separate projection layers in the state dict
run_convert_cli: run the RT-DETR checkpoint conversion CLI with model name, output path, and optional hub push
